title: Successor-level characterization of the polynomial hierarchy
statement: For every natural number $i$ and every language $L$ of binary strings, $L$ belongs to the $(i+1)$st existential level of the polynomial hierarchy if and only if there are natural numbers $C,c$ and a language $L'$ in the $i$th universal level such that, for every binary string $x$, membership $x\in L$ is equivalent to the existence of a binary string $u$ of length exactly $C(|x|+1)^c$ for which the self-delimiting pair encoding $\langle x,u\rangle$ belongs to $L'$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a language of binary strings
